title: Saquon Barkley sees advantages in the longer offseason following a shorter playoff run

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Saquon Barkley sees advantages in the longer offseason following a shorter playoff run
sources.description: "It's a little easier when you don't have to get ready right after the Super Bowl," Barkley said. Obviously the season didn't go as long as we want, but you get a little more time to work on yourself.
